name: Mobile App Development
tagline: Installable, mobile-first apps for your business — progressive web apps and cross-platform builds, without native app-store overhead.

hero.headline: Launch Your Business on Mobile, Without the Native App Timeline
hero.subhead: Progressive web apps and cross-platform mobile apps that work on iOS and Android from a single codebase.

description: You don't need two separate native apps to get a real mobile presence. I build Progressive Web Apps (installable, offline-capable, and app-store-free) and cross-platform apps with React Native/Expo that run on both iOS and Android from one codebase — ideal for ordering apps, booking apps, and internal staff tools that need to feel native without native-app timelines or cost.
problems: Your customers want to book, order, or check in from their phone, not a browser tab
You need an app but can't justify building separate iOS and Android apps
Your team needs a mobile tool for fieldwork, deliveries, or inventory checks
You want to test a mobile product idea before committing to a full native build
deliverables: Live installable Progressive Web App (add-to-home-screen, offline-capable, push notifications) or a React Native/Expo cross-platform build
App icon, splash screen, and branding assets
Integration with your existing backend or a new one built alongside it
App Store / Play Store submission support for cross-platform builds
Source code and admin/analytics dashboard access
Testing across real devices and screen sizes
features: One codebase for both iOS and Android via React Native/Expo
PWAs for zero app-store approval delay and instant updates
Business mobile apps: ordering, booking, staff and field tools
Same AI-assisted, brand-matched approach used across all Cyberussell builds

process.detail: Decide between a PWA (fastest, no app store) or a cross-platform app, based on your goals.
Mobile-first UI/UX design and wireframes for every core screen.
Development on React Native/Expo or as a PWA, connected to your backend.
Real-device testing across screen sizes and OS versions.
Deployment as an installable PWA, or submission support for the App Store / Play Store.

faqs.question: Should I build a PWA or a native-feeling app?
faqs.answer: If you want speed, no app-store approval wait, and instant updates, a PWA is usually the better first step. If you need deep device features or app-store presence, a React Native/Expo build is the way to go.

faqs.question: Do you handle App Store and Play Store submission?
faqs.answer: Yes, for cross-platform builds I support the submission process. Developer account fees (Apple/Google) are paid directly by you.

faqs.question: Will it work offline?
faqs.answer: PWAs support offline caching for core screens. Full offline data sync for cross-platform apps can be scoped as part of the build.

faqs.question: Can this connect to my existing website or system?
faqs.answer: Yes — the app can connect to your existing backend, or I can build a lightweight backend alongside it if you don't have one yet.
